info.description:en: A hall with fake sports functionality. The entire Salmicheh complex has been and continues to be a gathering center for armed Basij forces. The buildings of this block all belong to the Revolutionary Guard (IRGC) from Zand Street to Pasht Street, where the entrance to this large compound is located. Very important! Behind the Urban and Rural Development building, which is abandoned. All urban conflicts are managed from this area.

info.name:en: Military Logistics and Troop Movement Schools
info.description:en: According to field reports, certain public spaces including schools have been converted into logistics support centers and military troop movement hubs. In the Baharan area and around the Pavan three-way intersection, several educational centers are being used for organizing and shift changes, and Imam Shafi'i school behind the electricity office has also been converted into a location for stationing these personnel. Local sources have reported that movements are carried out by bus, with two buses bringing in new personnel and simultaneously two other buses removing personnel from the previous shift during each rotation. The timing of these activities is organized as 24 hours of operation followed by 24 hours of rest.
